audit_report.text: From January 1, 2022 to July 23, 2026, 12,247 of the 19,915 crashes citywide occurred at intersections, accounting for 61 percent of all crashes in Gainesville. An investigation of 1,834 intersections, including 1,414 with road design from imagery, identified 411 with repeat crashes and 241 above predicted for similar corners. Furthermore, 76 intersections have a clear fixable pattern. Locations on the fix list account for 358 crashes per year and 206 excess crashes per year. The worst intersection, SW 34th St & SW Archer Rd, exhibits 4.5 times the crash rate of similar intersections, with 60 crashes per year and 36 excess crashes per year. The recommended fix for this site is Dedicated right-turn lanes, followed on the fix list by SW 40th Blvd & SW Archer Rd with 42 crashes per year and 25 excess crashes per year.
